tool.name: GorderAa
tool.description: : Wrapper of the gorder atomistic module for computing lipid order parameters per atom for carbon tails.

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input TPR file
param.help: Path to the input structure or topology file. Format: [input].tpr

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input XTC,TRR,GRO file
param.help: Path to the input trajectory to be processed. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_order_path
param.label: output YAML,XVG,CSV name
param.help: Path to results of the order analysis Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: heavy_atoms
param.label: heavy_atoms
param.help: Selection query specifying the heavy atoms to be used in the analysis (typically carbon atoms in lipid tails).

param.name: hydrogens
param.label: hydrogens
param.help: Selection query specifiying the hydrogen atoms to be used in the analysis (only those bonded to heavy atoms will be considered).

param.name: handle_pbc
param.label: handle_pbc
param.help: If False, ignores periodic boundary conditions (PBC).
